g.text: SD02 - CLI Text Command (UC02; F01, F04, F09)
A terminal worker blocks in readCommand(), independently of the fixed loop.
Each completed line posts submitTextCommand(text) to that loop.
Each line has a new utteranceId and the same version/epoch checks as voice.
[still latest version/epoch; only context revision changed]
[fixed simulation ticks, including while readCommand() waits]
Increment revision if a timed action expired.
ActiveState moves the player and checks path/checkpoint/goal.
Display velocity, held directions, and lifecycle status too.
Coalesce ordinary tick output for readability; show fall,
SD03: contextual phrases; SD04: corrections, combined and timed actions.
SD05: fall recovery, checkpoint activation, and goal completion.
Provider failure uses SD01 handleInputFailure and releases controls;
the next explicit CLI line can retry. The CLI requires no microphone or ASR.
